source.title: Owner's idea in chat, 2026-10-20: 15-minute displacement, all day: a candle that closes beyond the previous candle's wick AND whose body is at least 2x the previous candle's body, entered with it

entry.words: On 15-minute GC candles in the evening, Asia, London and NY morning (18:00 the evening before .. 11:00 ET): when a candle closes above the previous candle's high and its body is at least 3x the previous candle's body, go long at the close; when it closes below the previous candle's low with a body at least 3x the previous body, go short.

[chat 2026-10-20] every time we close above the previous wicks candle and the candle body is 2x bigger than the previous candles body, then long, vice versa for shorts

[chat 2026-10-20] test GC on asia and evening and london

not_run: THE EXITS were not given: Claude used the house candle-break stop (the breaking candle's extreme, floored at 0.25 x ATR(14)) and a 1:0.5 target (the owner asked for it); the neighbours are 1:0.375 and 1:0.625.
THE WICK: a close strictly above the previous high (long) or strictly below the previous low (short).
THE BODY: |close - open| of the breaking candle >= 3 x |close - open| of the previous candle.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days); no trade is held past it.
THE CAP: none (the lane's 20 a pass); one position at a time inside a pass.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
FOUR PASSES (eve, asia, london, nyam), each its own instance: a trade of one pass may still be open when the next pass enters.
